en.name: Adam, peace be upon him
en.summary: The first of mankind and the father of the prophets. Allah created him with His own Hand, breathed into him from His spirit, and made the angels prostrate to him. He settled him in Paradise and taught him all the names. He tested him with a prohibition regarding a tree, and he ate from it through Satan's whispering, so Allah accepted his repentance and chose him, then sent him down to the earth to populate it with his offspring.

en.name: Idris, peace be upon him
en.summary: A truthful prophet among the earliest of the prophets, described by Allah with patience and truthfulness, and raised by Him to a high station. He is mentioned in the Qur'an in connection with the patient and righteous.

en.name: Nuh (Noah), peace be upon him
en.summary: The first of the messengers to the people of the earth. He called his people to the oneness of Allah for a thousand years less fifty, yet only a few believed. Allah commanded him to build the ark, so He drowned the disbelievers in the flood and saved the believers with him.

en.name: Hud, peace be upon him
en.summary: He was sent to the people of 'Aad, who dwelt in al-Ahqaf and were possessors of strength and mighty structures. He called them to worship Allah alone and to reject idols. They denied him and were arrogant, so Allah destroyed them with a furious, raging wind, and saved Hud and those who believed with him.

en.name: Salih, peace be upon him
en.summary: He was sent to the people of Thamud, who carved out the mountains as houses. He called them to the oneness of Allah and brought them the sign of the she-camel. They hamstrung the she-camel and denied him, so the Shout and the tremor seized them, and they lay lifeless, fallen prostrate in their homes.

en.name: Ibrahim (peace be upon him)
en.summary: The Friend of the Most Merciful and the leader of the monotheists, he smashed the idols of his people and Allah saved him from the fire, and he migrated for the sake of Allah. He built the Ka'bah together with his son Isma'il, and was tried with the sacrifice of his son, so Allah ransomed him with a great sacrifice, and placed prophethood among his descendants.

en.name: Lut (peace be upon him)
en.summary: The nephew of Ibrahim (son of his brother), he was sent to the people of Sodom who committed indecency with men, so he called them to abandon evil and worship Allah. They persisted in their misguidance, so Allah saved him and his family except his wife, and destroyed the town by overturning it and raining stones upon it.

en.name: Isma'il (peace be upon him)
en.summary: The firstborn son of Ibrahim, he was true to his promise and was a Messenger and Prophet, and he submitted to Allah's command when the sacrifice was presented to him. He shared with his father in raising the foundations of the Sacred House, and he commanded his family to prayer and zakat.

en.name: Ishaq (peace be upon him)
en.summary: The son of Ibrahim, glad tidings of him were given in the old age of his parents, and Allah made him a Prophet among the righteous. Allah granted him Ya'qub, and placed prophethood among his descendants.

en.name: Ya'qub (peace be upon him)
en.summary: The son of Ishaq, also called Isra'il, a Prophet from the descendants of Ibrahim whom Allah chose. He was patient over the loss of his son Yusuf until his eyes turned white from grief, and he enjoined his sons to monotheism at his death.

en.name: Yusuf (Joseph), peace be upon him
en.summary: The son of Ya'qub (Jacob), he saw a vision of the stars prostrating to him, so his brothers envied him and threw him into the well. He was tried with slavery and imprisonment, then Allah established him over the treasuries of Egypt, so he forgave his brothers and reunited his family, and his story is the best of stories.

en.name: Ayyub (Job), peace be upon him
en.summary: A patient prophet whom Allah tried in his body, his wealth, and his family, so he bore it with beautiful patience and complained only to his Lord. Allah answered his prayer, removed his affliction, and restored to him his family and the like of them along with them, and he was indeed an excellent, oft-returning servant.

en.name: Shu'ayb, peace be upon him
en.summary: He was sent to the people of Madyan and the Companions of the Thicket, who gave short measure and weight, so he called them to monotheism and to justice in dealings. They denied him and threatened him, so the tremor seized them, along with the punishment of the Day of the Shadow (the overshadowing cloud), and Allah saved Shu'ayb and those who believed with him.

en.name: Musa (Moses), peace be upon him
en.summary: The one to whom Allah spoke directly (Kalim Allah), he grew up in the house of Pharaoh, then Allah sent him as a messenger to him and gave him nine clear signs. He saved the Children of Israel and split the sea for them, drowning Pharaoh, and Allah revealed to him the Torah and spoke to him at Mount Tur.

en.name: Harun (Aaron), peace be upon him
en.summary: The brother and support of Musa, Musa asked his Lord to make him his minister (helper), so Allah answered and granted him to him as a prophet. He assisted Musa in calling Pharaoh, and succeeded him among his people, denouncing them for worshipping the calf.

en.name: Dhul-Kifl, peace be upon him
en.summary: A righteous prophet whom Allah mentioned among the patient, good people and admitted into His mercy. The Qur'an did not elaborate on his story, and limited itself to praising him for patience and righteousness.

en.name: David, peace be upon him
en.summary: A prophet-king to whom Allah gave the Psalms (Zabur), wisdom, and decisive speech, and subjected the mountains and birds to glorify with him. He softened iron for him, he killed Goliath (Jalut), and he was ever-turning to Allah, strong in worship, and just in judgment.

en.name: Solomon, peace be upon him
en.summary: Son of David; Allah gave him a mighty kingdom, taught him the language of birds, and subjected the jinn and the wind to him. He conversed with the hoopoe and corresponded with the Queen of Sheba, who then submitted (to Islam), and he was a grateful, ever-turning servant.

en.name: Elias (Ilyas), peace be upon him
en.summary: One of the messengers; he was sent to his people, calling them to worship Allah and forbidding them from worshipping the idol 'Ba'l'. Most of them denied him, so he warned them, and Allah preserved good praise for him among later generations.

en.name: Al-Yasa' (Elisha), peace be upon him
en.summary: A righteous prophet whom Allah favored above the worlds and counted among the good. The Qur'an mentioned him among the prophets without detailing his story.

en.name: Yunus (Jonah), peace be upon him
en.summary: Dhul-Nun (the Companion of the Fish), sent to the people of Nineveh. He became angry and left in anger before his Lord's permission, so the fish swallowed him in the darkness of the sea. He called upon his Lord in glorification and confession, so Allah saved him, and his people believed, so He let them enjoy life for a while.

en.name: Zakariya (Zechariah), peace be upon him
en.summary: A prophet who was the guardian of Maryam (Mary). He called upon his Lord secretly to grant him an heir to inherit from him, though he had reached old age and his wife was barren. So Allah gave him the glad tidings of Yahya (John), and made his sign that he would not speak to people for three nights while being sound (in health).

en.name: Yahya (John), peace be upon him
en.summary: Son of Zakariya. Allah gave his father glad tidings of him and made him a chief (sayyid), chaste, and a prophet from among the righteous. Allah granted him wisdom while still a boy, and dutifulness to his parents, and peace was upon him the day he was born, the day he dies, and the day he is raised alive.

en.name: Isa (Jesus), peace be upon him
en.summary: Son of Maryam (Mary). Allah created him without a father, and he spoke to people in the cradle. Allah gave him the Injil (Gospel) and supported him with miracles by Allah's permission, such as reviving the dead and healing the blind and the leper. He gave glad tidings of a messenger to come after him, and Allah raised him up to Himself; he was not killed nor crucified.

en.name: Muhammad ﷺ
en.summary: The Seal of the Prophets and the best of creation. Allah sent him as a mercy to the worlds with the Noble Qur'an, the last of the Books. He called to the oneness of Allah (Tawhid) and through him the religion was perfected. He was of great character, and Allah sent him to all of mankind as a bringer of glad tidings and a warner.
